data.why: The repo ships a ready-made sample input workbook (示例输入.xlsx) matching the exact sheet layout api.py expects (功能区/支流 input sheet + 逐日流量 sheet per scheme), and api.py itself also serves it at GET /api/sample; a stub hydro_api_helpers.py is seeded because api.py imports it from a private devtools monorepo that is not published with this repo.

goals: Upload the built-in sample workbook and compute the river's monthly pollutant receiving capacity across its functional zones
Compare receiving capacity under multiple pollution scenarios (方案1, 方案2, ...) defined in the same workbook's 逐日流量 sheets
Account for tributary (支流) segments joining the main stream at specific positions and see their effect on downstream capacity
Check whether a reservoir zone is present and, if so, read its monthly storage volume and receiving capacity
Download the full multi-sheet Excel result (daily/monthly capacity, process table, final result table) for further analysis

review.summary: The tree accurately records how to drive this API-only tool: sample download, compute with json or xlsx, and the parsed-input preview. Its screens and the downloaded files back up what it claims. It stops at 'got a response', leaves out the monthly and zone-level results that are the scientific point, and spends a phase on health checks, so it needs a results-interpretation phase, corrected not_done notes and citations, and nodes for the template, multiple scenarios and the reservoir before filing.
